steps.title: Supply shifted right
steps.say: You increased supply! Moving the blue curve to the right means sellers are offering more goods at every price.

ops.text: Why more supply lowers the price

steps.title: Surplus leads to lower prices
steps.say: With more goods available than before, sellers must lower their prices to compete and sell everything, pushing the price down to 4.

steps.title: Try shifting demand
steps.say: Now try dragging the red demand curve to the right to see what happens when buyer demand rises instead!
